name: Fuji Photo Gallery Ginza
about_text: Fuji Photo Gallery Ginza is an exhibition space operated by CREATE, the professional photo lab founded in 1981 (as Photo Lab Create Tokyo) that has long supported photographers and photo enthusiasts through fine printmaking. Located since 2016 in the Success Ginza First Building near Ginza and Kyobashi stations, the gallery gives professional and amateur photographers alike a place to present silver-halide (gelatin silver) prints as finished works of art. The program emphasizes the tonal depth and craftsmanship of chromogenic printing, hosting both invited and open-call ('kobo') exhibitions. The gallery operates alongside CREATE's print production and framing services, positioning itself as a bridge between photographic creation and public presentation in central Tokyo.
